title: Patient Empowerment through immersive hospital experiences before operations or procedures (Anesthesie)
summary: This project aims to foster empathy among physicians and anesthesia nurses by allowing them to experience the patient’s perspective through immersive 3D videos. By virtually going through preoperative procedures up to the induction of anesthesia from the viewpoint of a bedridden person, participants gain direct insight into patients’ emotional stress. This innovative approach supports long-term understanding, sensitivity, and empathy in clinical practice.
conditions: The study does is a supportive and complementary method to clinical procedures and does not offer medical treatment (please see the project description).

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Anesthesiologists or anesthesia nurses at the CCM, ≥18 years old, capable of giving informed consent, with sufficient German language skills, and normal or corrected vision.
Exclusion criteria:
Epilepsy or visually triggered seizure disorders, severe history of VR intolerance (motion sickness), acute psychotic disorders, acute vestibular disturbances, prior participation in a PERISKOP study, or severe uncorrectable visual impairments.
